{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 16 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore carries a tight ISO fit tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the drawing specifies an I.Z.B.P. plating without any allowance for coating thickness. The added plating will reduce the bore below its H7 limit and prevent the mating shaft from assembling. The designer must either increase the pre-plate bore size to account for the specified plating thickness or add a note requiring the hole to be re-machined after plating."
  , "recommended_correction": "Adjust the pre-plate dimension of D12 to allow for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness, or add a note specifying that the ⌀16 H7 bore is to be machined to final size after plating."}]}
